title: ADG common contract definitions (v1)
description: Shared definitions referenced by every ADG collector contract. Collectors report observations; they never report conclusions. See docs/contracts/collector-protocol.md.

schemaVersion.title: Contract schema version
schemaVersion.description: Major version 1. A minor bump is additive and backward compatible; a breaking change requires a new major directory (v2) and a migration note.

sid.title: Security identifier
sid.description: String-form SID. The canonical identity of every principal: upper-case S, no leading zeros, decimal identifier authority below 2^32 and 0x-prefixed hexadecimal above. Names are never identity.

domainSid.title: Domain or machine SID
domainSid.description: A SID of the form S-1-5-21-x-y-z with no RID.

timestamp.title: Timezone-aware timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp that MUST carry an offset (Z or +/-HH:MM). A naive timestamp is rejected: observations from hosts in different time zones would otherwise be unorderable.

sourceKey.title: Stable source key
sourceKey.description: Deterministic identity of the observed object, derived only from its identifying fields. Ingestion is idempotent on (run_id, source_key). The derivation for each observation kind is fixed in docs/contracts/collector-protocol.md and is recomputed and verified server-side.

accessMask.title: Windows access mask
accessMask.description: Raw unsigned 32-bit access mask exactly as read from the descriptor, generic bits included. Collectors must not expand generic rights or otherwise interpret the mask.

aceFlags.title: Raw ACE header flags
aceFlags.description: The ACE_HEADER.AceFlags byte: OBJECT_INHERIT 0x01, CONTAINER_INHERIT 0x02, NO_PROPAGATE_INHERIT 0x04, INHERIT_ONLY 0x08, INHERITED 0x10. Unknown bits are preserved rather than dropped.

aclHash.title: Normalized DACL digest
aclHash.description: SHA-256, lower-case hexadecimal, taken over the canonical normalized form of the DACL (docs/architecture/ntfs-acl-normalization.md). It covers dacl_present, dacl_protected, and the ACEs' trustee/type/mask/flags in evaluation order; it deliberately excludes the owner, because every folder under a root is legitimately owned by whoever created it while sharing one inherited DACL. Added in contract 1.2.

aceType.description: DACL entry type. Audit (SACL) entries govern logging, not access, and must never be reported here.

aceSource.description: Whether the ACE was set on this object or inherited from an ancestor. Must agree with bit 0x10 of ace_flags.

groupType.description: Distribution groups never grant access. 'unknown' means the source did not say, which must not be reported as 'harmless'.

membershipEdgeKind.description: primary_group exists because primaryGroupID membership does not appear in a group's member attribute; omitting it under-reports access for every user in the domain.

sharePermission.description: The three levels reported by the SMB management cmdlets.

hostName.title: Windows host name
hostName.description: A host name alone, never a UNC path and never a path fragment.

uncPath.title: Canonical UNC path
uncPath.description: Absolute UNC path identifying a resource: \\server\share[\path]. Relative paths, '.' and '..' segments, drive-letter paths, and extended-length prefixes are rejected; a resource identified only by a local path is ambiguous because the server is unknown.

localPath.title: Drive-letter path on the server
localPath.description: Supplementary only. A local path never identifies a resource on its own.

scopeKind.title: Reconciliation scope kind
scopeKind.description: What a run claims to have enumerated completely. Absence of an object may only be inferred inside a scope a successful run reconciled.

key.description: Identity of the scope: a domain SID, a case-folded host name, a share key, or a canonical UNC path.

source.title: Observation source
source.description: Who saw the fact and how. The reading method is evidence, not a label: different mechanisms report different detail (share permissions as levels versus masks, for instance).
